hash_convention: Sources: UTF-8 normalized LF without BOM; reports/logs: raw bytes. Final commit is identified by PR HEAD; source hashes bind tested state without a circular commit hash.
evidence_limits: PostgreSQL 17 and RabbitMQ Testcontainers are disposable, not operational databases/brokers.
